experiment_data.hypothesis: For finite-budget partial-pooling EC-HTE, accounting for confusion-matrix estimation uncertainty with sandwich or paired bootstrap intervals improves subgroup CATE CI coverage relative to a naive outcome-only delta interval.

spec.command: bash -c "set -euo pipefail; cd /root/ec_hte; mkdir -p docs/results logs; /root/miniconda3/bin/python experiments/e003_inference_coverage_ablation.py --n 5000 --reps 120 --budget 1000 --bootstrap 80 --seed 20260531 --out docs/results/e003_inference_coverage_ablation.json 2>&1 | tee logs/e003_inference_coverage_ablation.log"
